proved: Answer analysis resolves scoped configuration and routes EXTRACTION through the central gateway with its existing execution lease heartbeat.
Configured primary503/fallback, output and timeout run through the real gateway with a dark provider seam.
Changed configuration before dispatch or fallback and an unadmittable request ceiling defer the owned lease; existing lease loss, malformed output and ordinary provider failure paths remain distinct.
limits: Provider-dark composition and unit proof; no live provider, tenant configuration change, spending or deployment.
Configuration is compared at the existing admission boundary; no atomic transaction across provider I/O or rollback of already-dispatched work is claimed.
Native lease/deferral proof, where retained separately, proves the canonical persistence helper rather than complete worker/provider execution.

nativePersistenceProof.scope: Canonical PostgreSQL lease/defer helper persistence; separate from dark-provider worker composition.
